products.name: Turmeric powder
products.about: Ground from dried, polished turmeric rhizomes. Bright golden yellow with a warm, earthy, slightly bitter taste.
products.uses: Curries, dals, rice, pickles and marinades.
products.storage: Keep in an airtight container away from light, heat and moisture.

products.name: Kashmiri chilli powder
products.about: Ground from mild Kashmiri-type red chillies. Gives a deep red colour with gentle heat.

products.storage: Keep in an airtight container away from light, heat and moisture.

products.name: Red chilli powder
